Train smarter and recover better with this 10 min full body mobility routine for Jiu Jitsu (BJJ). This quick yoga-based mobility flow is designed to help improve flexibility, increase joint range of motion, reduce stiffness, and support faster recovery after training, rolling, or lifting.
In this class, we’ll focus on key mobility areas for Brazilian Jiu Jitsu athletes including hips, hamstrings, spine, shoulders, and thoracic rotation to help improve movement quality both on and off the mats.
